rules.external: marked invalid (corrupted image or wrong/missing label) in the manual check of calfa-co/rasam-dataset PR #7 (RASAM-1 only)
rules.garbled: reference far less probable under a character LM than what two cross-fitted readers read (reference text does not match the image)
rules.garbled_page: on a page whose references are, as a whole, much less probable than the readings (MS 1977 pages 0017, 0071, 0158)
rules.blank: crop contains no ink, or reference is empty
rules.shifted: reference belongs to a neighbouring line (another line of the page reads it)
rules.vertical: crop is a vertical / marginal strip that cannot be read as the reference
rules.truncated: crop is cut short; the page image does not hold the full reference either
